{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the ID card|the [[Covenant identichip]]s that the Jedi Covenant put on their Sith artifacts}}
[[File:BailOrganaIdentichip-SithSnapshot.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] identity tag]]

Commonly referred to as an '''identity chit''', '''identi-tab''', '''identicard''', '''ID card''', '''passport chip''', '''microtag''', or '''identity tag''', '''identichips''' were small and could easily be attached to clothing or carried for use by basic card readers.

==History==
Identi-tabs were usually equipped with a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] image of the owner. They were another security measure introduced by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] because of the growing risk of a war on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Vannix]] Intelligence was known to use identichips with unique seals. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all citizens were required to possess some form of identification, a regulation that some, such as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] found unnecessary and irritating. While attempting to board his consular vessel, [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], Bail was forced to show his identity tag to a dubious [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]].

Certain identichips bore distinguishing marks granting their owners a degree of legal immunity. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], for example, possessed an identichip with first degree civilian immunity, which was the highest privilege obtainable for a civilian, during her work for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the early Imperial period.

==Identicard==
[[File:Fake_ID.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Wookiee holding a fake ID]]
Identicards were a form of personalized [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] used during the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Contained on the card was a large amount of personal information, including physical and medical data. It was relatively easy to create fake identities, something criminals and scam artists took advantage of during the war with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
